jobs.title: Digital Literacy Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Conard House, Inc. is a non-profit organization that focuses on empowering people and restoring hope for our community members and workforce. We work with a diverse adult population and strive for cultural competency by respecting experience, promoting inclusion and building community. The position is with the SF Connected program, which provides various services including: computer training, resume building, tablet training, social media training, and other services that improve the quality of life/independence of older adults and adults with disabilities in San Francisco. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Conard House is a committed equal opportunity employer.

**DUTIES:**

* Develop curriculum for classes that is suitable for Conard House consumers that will include usage of computers and commonly used software and apps.
* Train and assist consumers on assistive technologies and accessibility features to promote independence and enhance consumers’ daily living.
* Design and implement training programs that will help improve and enhance daily living for consumers.
* Assist consumers with job search process, including resume revision, cover letter composition, and online applications.
* Assist consumers with troubleshooting on personal tech devices, platforms, and processes. Maintain the ability to adjust approach(es) as needed to best suit consumer needs.
* Host/train consumers and volunteers on video conferencing platforms/software to allow clients to learn, participate/engage in virtual activities and virtual learning opportunities.
* Coordinate workshops, guest speakers, and special events that promote digital inclusion and community engagement.
* Deliver personalized strength-based training; encourage and support participant interaction.
* Coordinate, train, support, and oversee volunteers and interns assisting with Digital Literacy programming.
* Develop and disseminate program materials to all Conard sites.
* Conduct program outreach, both internally at associated Conard sites as well as with potential and established external partners.
* Coordinate class scheduling with site supervisors in the community.
* Design group activities that promote social connection opportunities for consumers.
* Track program objectives and class attendance, including individual usage and student progress.
* Collect & compile data for distribution of monthly reports and input data into the appropriate database.
* Coordinate Digital Literacy program inventory, including ordering and tracking incoming and outgoing devices.
* Maintain accurate program records and ensure compliance with agency, contract, and confidentiality requirements.
* Manage technology equipment, coordinate security of equipment at sites, report issues with equipment or lab operations.
* Coordinate and network with other agencies that are participating in SF Connected. Attend meetings as required.
* Maintain a classroom environment suitable for collaborative learning.
* Be available to assist consumers virtually and remotely.
* Others duties as assigned.

High School Diploma required; Bachelor's degree preferred. Must have at least two years of experience in a technology-focused, educational, or human services role working with diverse populations. Demonstrate the ability to clearly communicate ideas, information, and technical concepts to individuals and groups with varying levels of knowledge, education, and digital literacy, while providing troubleshooting, training, and technology guidance in a supportive and accessible manner. Demonstrate positive customer service and client-centered approaches when interacting with participants, staff, volunteers, and community members. Must be comfortable with public speaking, group facilitation, and delivering presentations, classes, or workshops. Demonstrate experience developing, implementing, and evaluating curriculum, educational materials, or training programs, as well as coordinating projects and collaborating effectively across diverse teams, departments, and community partners. Experience working with and supervising volunteers is highly desirable. Must complete a background check after conditional job offer.

**DEPARTMENT: Member Services**  
**REPORTS TO: Call Center Supervisor**  
**LOCATION: Native American Health Center (NAHC)**  
**3124 International Blvd, Oakland, CA 94601**  
**WORK HOURS: Full Time, 40 hours per week, 100% FTE**  
**STATUS: Union, Non-Exempt**

**POSITION SUMMARY**  
The Call Center Coordinator (CCC) will work as part of a larger team that provides high quality medical, dental, and behavioral health care to NAHC’s members. The CCC will be the first point of contact for members and all others who contact NAHC, therefore superior customer service skill is key. The CCC will answer calls, schedule appointments, provide information, and offer support for members using the member portal. The CCC will follow a script on resolving issues for members with the goal of eliminating abandoned and missed phone calls in an effort to increase access to primary care and to resolve member problems expeditiously. This position is key in member satisfaction. Emphasis on customer service is paramount.

The Native American Health Center is an accredited institution and adheres to the standards of excellence set forth by the Accreditation Association of Ambulatory Health Care (AAAHC) and the Commission of Dental Accreditation (CODA).

1. Create and maintain a welcoming atmosphere by greeting all members in a courteous and professional manner.  
2. Answer all incoming calls timely and professionally via the Automatic Call Distribution (ACD) system.  
3. Inform members of processes and procedures related to their reason for calling, and answer inquiries about services, insurances, and eligibility and registration services.  
4. Schedule appointments appropriately into the Practice Management system (PMS). This will include booking, canceling, and rescheduling appointments.  
5. Proactively manage and “tetris” appointment scheduling to maximize productivity and to fill appointment gaps.

14. Log all reported Teletask system inconsistencies and submit to supervisor daily.  
15. Manage No-Show Report and collaborate with Medical to complete appropriate follow up tasks daily.  
16. Maintain and update member account demographics in NextGen at time of contact.  
17. Answer member inquiries about financial responsibility, insurance and benefits, account status, and treatment planning.  
18. Screen members’ eligibility for possible care coverage (e.g., county or state programs; sliding scale, etc.) Inform members of program limitations and ensure  
members understand the information conveyed.  
19. Confirm members’ insurance eligibility on all scheduled appointments at least two days prior to scheduled appointments. Notify members in a timely manner of changes in schedules and to insurance benefits.

29. Must demonstrate professionalism and courtesy at all times to both internal and external customers (members and staff alike.) Customer service goals and

**Company Overview:** Established in California in 2013, Green Water and Power has rapidly grown to operate in over 35 states, positioning itself as a leader in the sustainable energy sector. Named the #1 electric vehicle (EV) installer in America, we take pride in having deployed more than 15,000 EV chargers and completed approximately 5 megawatts (MW) of solar energy projects.

As an EVITP (Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Training Program) certified turnkey engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) firm, we leverage our in-house expertise to efficiently manage and execute large-scale projects. Our dedication to sustainability and quality extends beyond project completion; we also provide comprehensive operation and maintenance services to ensure optimal performance for the projects we develop, as well as for third-party installations.

**Position Overview:** Green Water and Power is seeking an experienced Project Manager/Foreman to own commercial EV charging projects while leading installation work directly on site. This role combines the hands-on technical leadership of a Foreman with the planning, and client communication of a Project Manager. You will supervise an installation crew, manage project schedules and coordinate with engineering, procurement, and local authorities, and serve as the customer’s primary point of contact. Your leadership will be crucial in delivering safe, code-compliant, high-quality installations on schedule.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage commercial EV charging projects for the entirety of the project.
* Review plan designs and single-line diagrams with the engineering department; build project schedules and crew plans for each site.
* Coordinate with procurement and supply chain teams to ensure timely availability and delivery of chargers, materials, and equipment.

* Schedule and lead preconstruction site walks and postconstruction site inspections.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients: coordinate start times and project schedules, provide regular updates, and resolve concerns promptly.

* Conduit and Raceway Work: Skilled in EMT and PVC conduit installation; able to bend, mount, and seal per job specs.
* Grounding and Bonding: Capable of installing compliant grounding systems for EVSE units and subpanels.
* Testing and Commissioning: Use of electrical testing tools (multimeter, insulation resistance testers, etc.) for system validation and diagnostics.
* Conduct site visits to monitor progress, troubleshoot issues, and implement solutions to keep projects on track.
* Lead and mentor Junior and Senior Level EV Installers, providing guidance, technical support, and promoting a culture of continuous improvement.
* Promote a culture of safety within the installation teams, ensuring strict adherence to safety protocols, procedures, and best practices.
* Document punch list items, photo document progress, and submit daily status and job closeout reports to management, ensuring projects are on time and on budget.
* Maintain accurate and comprehensive records of project details, installations, maintenance activities, and repairs.
* Accountable for tools, equipment, and company vehicles, ensuring all are in good working order and that project sites are properly cleaned up.
* Must be responsive to emails and phone calls from clients, crews, and management.

**Qualifications:**

* 4-6 years of experience as an Electrical Foreman or Lead Installer, preferably in EV infrastructure or renewable energy.
* 2+ years of project management experience on commercial electrical or construction projects, including scheduling and budget tracking.
* DIR Licensed Journeyman or Master Electrician (preferred).
* Strong knowledge of the NEC, including Articles 625 and 690.
* Ability to read and interpret construction plans, specifications, and single-line diagrams.
* EVITP Certification or the ability to obtain one.
* An OSHA 30 certification or the ability to obtain one.
* Proven experience with EV charger deployment and solar panel and canopy installations.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and project scheduling tools.
* Strong leadership and mentoring skills.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and organizational abilities.

**General Requirements:**

* Valid driver's license, clean driving record, and access to reliable transportation.
* Physical ability to lift and maneuver heavy equipment (up to 50 lbs.).
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* High attention to detail and safety.
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once and prioritize deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in field and office environments.
* Comfortable working outdoors, at heights, and in varying weather conditions.

At Vestis®, we provide uniforms, workplace supplies, and professional cleaning that help businesses simplify their workday and keep their teams safe, confident, and focused on what matters most. More than a provider, we are a partner in productivity, trusted to keep you running.
  
Join us and build a career supporting the people who make it all work.
  
  
This versatile, hands-on role supports Vice President, Corp IT by connecting project and portfolio coordination, budgeting and financial administration, purchase and vendor management, reporting and dashboarding, data analysis, process improvement, team operations, and executive decision support. The position brings structure, visibility, and follow-through to a fast-moving technology organization by helping track priorities, budgets, risks, decisions, commitments, and key initiatives across the VP's portfolio. Leveraging judgment, discretion, communication, anticipation, and relationship management skills developed through executive support experience, the role serves as a trusted operational partner that helps turn strategy into execution
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
IT Project and Portfolio Management
  
  
Support VP Corp IT in tracking key technology initiatives by maintaining project plans, milestones, status updates, risks, actions, and dependencies across assigned platforms and business priorities.
  
  
Prepare project dashboards, reporting, and follow-up actions to help ensure deliverables, decisions, budgets, and stakeholder commitments remain on track.
  
  
Purchase Requisitions, Purchase Orders & Billing
  
  
Coordinate purchasing and invoicing activities for the technology portfolio by creating requisitions, tracking purchase orders, monitoring invoice processing, and maintaining spend visibility.
  
  
Maintain procurement and financial trackers while partnering with Finance, Procurement, Accounts Payable, and vendors to resolve issues and support budget administration activities.
  
  
Light Procurement & Vendor Administration
  
  
Support vendor and contract administration activities by coordinating renewals, collecting quotes, maintaining contract and subscription inventories, and monitoring key commercial dates and commitments.
  
  
Prepare vendor-related reporting and documentation while facilitating onboarding, compliance requirements, and routine procurement workflows in partnership with internal support teams.
  
  
Process Improvement & Automation
  
  
Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve reporting, automate manual processes, and standardize operational practices.
  
  
Develop templates, trackers, and dashboards that improve efficiency and visibility.
  
  
IT, Business Operations Support
  
  
Serve as a trusted operational partner to the VP, Corp IT by preparing presentations, leadership materials, operating reviews, decision support documents, and executive communications.
  
  
Manage governance trackers, risks, actions, decisions, and special projects while coordinating follow-through across business, IT, vendor, and finance stakeholders.
  
  
Coordination & Workforce Assist
  
  
Support team operations for VP, Corp IT by maintaining resource, contractor, vendor, onboarding, offboarding, staffing, and workload progress trackers and dashboarding, and coordinating follow-up on key team commitments and deliverables.
  
  
Facilitate communication and operational alignment by coordinating team updates, communications, planning activities, action items, and accountability tracking to help ensure clear ownership, deadlines, and execution of priorities.
  
  
Reporting, Dashboarding & Business Insights
  
  
Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and executive reporting that provide visibility into project status, budgets, vendor performance, resource utilization, risks, milestones, and operational metrics across their manager’s technology portfolio.
  
  
Analyze and consolidate data from multiple sources to prepare leadership-ready reports, trend analysis, executive summaries, and insights that support planning, prioritization, and decision-making.
  
  
Success Profile & Executive Support Strengths
  
  
A trusted, low-ego operator who can move fluidly between project delivery, analytics, financial detail, team coordination, and executive communication. new_jobs.description:
The US Operate Strategy & Execution team is a cross-business strategy function that helps shape and execute the growth agenda for BO&I US Operate, specifically supporting the build of new capabilities that further our LTP aspirations. We work alongside business, offering, industry, and enabling-function leaders to identify strategic opportunities, assess investment priorities, mobilize the capabilities and resources required to create and deliver new services, and facilitate execution of the particular investment.  
  
The initial focus for this role will be **Industry Innovation**: identifying where changing client needs, industry disruption, emerging technologies, and evolving delivery models create opportunities for US Operate to differentiate, grow, and scale. The role will help businesses and leaders move priority opportunities from insight and strategy through investment decisions, service creation, pilot activity, commercialization, and execution.  
  
Over time, the role may expand to additional US Operate strategy priorities, including growth strategy, portfolio development, sales growth, commercialization, operating-model evolution, strategic partnerships, and/or other cross-business initiatives.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on October 23, 2026  
  
**Work you'll do:**  
  
As a Business Strategy Manager - US Operate, you will lead selected strategic workstreams on behalf of the US Operate Strategy & Execution team. You will help business leaders make informed choices, align stakeholders, mobilize investments, and move new services from concept to execution.  
  
You will:  
  

* Lead cross-business strategy workstreams that address priority US Operate growth opportunities, including problem definition, market and industry assessment, strategic options, investment recommendations, execution planning, and outcome tracking.

* Identify opportunities for new services and capabilities and work with business leaders to assess their strategic relevance, market potential, differentiation, scalability, and organizational requirements.

  

* Co-develop service concepts with the businesses, helping translate market and client needs into viable service propositions, capability requirements, pilot approaches, and commercialization pathways.

  

* Build investment decision materials that clarify the opportunity, strategic rationale, expected value, required resources, risks, dependencies, and choices for leadership consideration.

  

* Help mobilize investments alongside the businesses by coordinating the people, funding, technology, leadership attention, and other resources needed to test, develop, and scale priority initiatives.

  

* Orchestrate incubation, piloting, and scaling activities across business and enabling teams, ensuring that decision gates, handoffs, dependencies, and ownership are clear.

  

* Partner with business leaders on go-to-market and commercialization planning, including target industries and clients, value propositions, market points of view, differentiated messaging, pursuit enablement, and scaling requirements.

  

* Facilitate executive governance and decision-making by preparing leadership meetings, framing decisions, surfacing trade-offs, documenting actions, and maintaining momentum across complex initiatives.

new_jobs.title: Recruitment Operations Manager — AI Workflow Review
new_jobs.description:
Recruitment Operations Manager — AI Workflow Review is a remote review track for evaluating AI outputs across recruiting workflows. Reviewers grade workflow correctness, policy adherence, and stakeholder fit; flag operational risk; and document the right next step so the modeling team can train on it.

**Why this role matters**
-------------------------

Recruiting AI has to fit into an actual day at work. AuraOne uses experienced operators to grade outputs the way a senior peer would — checking workflow, policy, and the unwritten rules that decide whether a task actually gets done.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Review AI outputs against current recruiting workflows, playbooks, and firm policy for Recruitment Operations Manager — AI Workflow Review assignments.
* Grade tone, escalation logic, and stakeholder fit on a structured rubric.
* Flag operational risk, missed escalations, and policy-adherence gaps with severity tags.
* Capture the right next step so the modeling team can train on it.
* Adjudicate disputed treatments against published playbooks or firm guidance.
* Maintain reviewer-quality scores in inter-rater calibration cycles.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Direct working experience in recruiting on real teams for Recruitment Operations Manager — AI Workflow Review work.
* Comfort applying multi-page rubrics consistently across long batches.
* Clear written reasoning that names the policy or workflow being applied.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to flag when a prompt itself is the problem.
* Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week.

**Example tasks**
-----------------

* Grade a model's response to a real recruiting ticket and rate workflow, tone, and escalation.
* Flag a missed escalation with the right severity tag and corrected next step.
* Adjudicate a disputed playbook call between two reviewers using firm guidance.
* Audit a 25-row batch for rubric consistency and report drift to the program lead.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Prior experience training, calibrating, or QA-ing operations teams.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted workflow tooling and its failure modes.
* Bilingual experience for cross-region operations.

**Skills**
----------

* Operational review
* Policy adherence
* Workflow judgment
* Stakeholder communication
* Recruiting

**Work model**
--------------

Remote — US-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US.

**Compensation**
----------------

Hourly rate confirmed after the interview process.

**Application process**
-----------------------

Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Account Manager to join our growing sales team. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for our valued clients, fostering strong relationships and driving revenue growth through strategic account management. Your energetic approach and consultative selling skills will help you identify client needs, present tailored solutions, and close deals efficiently. This position offers an exciting opportunity to leverage your technology sales expertise and thrive in a fast-paced, innovative environment committed to excellence.

**Duties**

* Develop and nurture long-term relationships with existing clients, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and retention
* Conduct outbound calling campaigns to generate new business opportunities and expand account portfolios
* Engage in consultative selling by understanding client needs and recommending appropriate products or services
* Utilize CRM software, including Salesforce or similar platforms, to track interactions, manage pipelines, and forecast sales

* Negotiate contract terms, pricing, and deal structures to maximize value for both clients and the company

* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, competitive landscape, and product offerings to effectively position solutions
